name: BlueCart
description_en:
BlueCart serves wholesale commerce through supplier catalogs, buyer ordering, invoicing, payments and delivery workflows. Its public material also describes a restaurant inventory application.

These are related but distinct perspectives: a distributor manages customer orders, while a restaurant tracks ingredients and purchasing needs. An evaluation should identify which side of the transaction the organization operates before comparing modules.
description_zh:
BlueCart 通过供应商目录、买家订购、开票、支付及配送流程服务批发交易，公开资料也介绍餐饮库存应用。

两者相关但职责不同：经销商管理客户订单，餐厅跟踪食材和采购需求。比较模块前应先明确企业位于交易的哪一侧。

core_features.explanation_en: Supplier-facing material connects catalogs and buyer accounts with order, invoice and payment handling.
core_features.explanation_zh: 供应商资料将商品目录、买家账户与订单、发票及付款处理连接。

core_features.explanation_en: Restaurant material describes par levels, reorder alerts, purchase orders and invoice/receipt discrepancies.
core_features.explanation_zh: 餐厅资料介绍目标库存、补货提醒、采购单及发票与收货差异。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Follow an ingredient from count to supplier order
sections.title_zh: 跟踪食材从盘点到供应商采购
sections.en: For a restaurant evaluation, establish ingredient units and par levels, record stock and review replenishment suggestions. BlueCart says purchase orders can be reviewed by staff or sent automatically. Match deliveries against invoices and examine flagged discrepancies before relying on food-cost reporting. Unit conversion and recipe yields deserve a representative test.
sections.zh: 餐厅评估可先确定食材单位和目标库存，录入数量后检查补货建议。BlueCart 表示采购单可由员工审核或自动发送。应将到货与发票核对并处理标记差异，再使用食材成本报表；单位换算和配方出品率需用代表性样本测试。

sections.en: The supplier offering focuses on selling wholesale products through a catalog and managing buyers, invoices, payments and delivery zones. Endless Aisle is presented as a marketplace capability. Do not assume a restaurant buyer’s stock controls or a distributor’s delivery settings are automatically available in the other offering. Confirm the exact product configuration in the demonstration.
sections.zh: 供应商方案侧重通过目录批发销售，并管理买家、发票、付款与配送区域；Endless Aisle 被介绍为市场平台能力。不能假设餐厅买家的库存控制或经销商配送设置自动适用于另一方案，应在演示中确认具体产品配置。

sections.title_zh: 索取明确范围的商务报价
sections.en: The official sales page offers a demonstration rather than a numeric price schedule. The pages read did not establish a current base subscription, billing unit, implementation charge or payment-processing fee. A free demo is not evidence of a permanently free operating plan. Quote requests should specify buyer/supplier role, locations, catalog size, transactions and required modules.
sections.zh: 官方销售页提供演示预约，没有数值价目表。已读页面未确认当前基础订阅、计费单位、实施费或支付处理费；免费演示不代表长期免费运营方案。询价应明确买家或供应商角色、地点、目录规模、交易量和所需模块。

sections.title_zh: 自动采购前检查控制规则
sections.en: The restaurant workflow is relevant to teams coordinating ingredient counts and purchasing; the wholesale workflow suits suppliers digitizing recurring buyer orders. Before automatic ordering, test a short delivery, duplicate invoice and changed pack size. Confirm who approves exceptions and how records leave the system. No live supplier connection or payment was exercised.
sections.zh: 餐厅流程适合协调食材盘点与采购的团队；批发流程适合将重复买家订单数字化的供应商。启用自动采购前应测试短交、重复发票和包装规格变化，并确认例外审批人与数据导出方式。未实际运行供应商连接或付款。
